component.name: iProjection (Unofficial)
component.summary: Control and cast to Epson projectors from Linux

description.p: iProjection (Unofficial) (linux-iprojection) is a native Linux application built by John Varghese (J0X) to control and cast to Epson projectors seamlessly via the ESC/VP.net and EShare protocols.
Enterprise error reporting and bug fixes.

ul.li: Fixed GStreamer caps negotiation for VA-API and NVENC hardware encoders.
Bounded screen capture resolution to 1080p to fit projector hardware limits.
Fixed crash on start (log_writer TypeError) affecting some distros.
Added automated crash reporting with one-click GitHub issue generation.
